newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse rises on week, helped by Guinness.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse rises on week, helped by Guinness.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index ended the week higher with brewers Guinness Ghana Ltd and banks helping the rally, its market reports showed.
The Index rose 0.96 points to 354.01 points on Friday as bids for the first time this year outpaced offers by 2,441,770 to 1,889,520. A hefty 1,216,970 shares changed hands.
Guinness Ghana Ltd (+35 cedis to 350 cedis) was the main riser on Friday. Enterprise Insurance Co rose 20 cedis to 470..
The Index, which ended the previous week at 346.66 points, rose seven points on Monday, with Social Security Bank gaining 110 cedis to 1,200 and Ghana Commercial Bank up 10 to 640.

On Friday, manufacturing and trading company Paterson Zochonis fell 68 to 300, followed by agro-processor and trading company UNILEVER, down 10 to 750, UTC-ESTATES, down five to 55 and trading group CFAO CFAO.GH, down one to 18.
